Strong leadership, hands-on automation expertise, and the ability to drive QA transformation while ensuring regulatory compliance, system stability, and quality excellence across web, mobile, and backend systems    Benefits  Opportunity to work as part of a dynamic team with growth opportunities  Hybrid working   Task & responsibilities   QA Leadership & Delivery Management    Lead end-to-end QA activities for banking applications including Retail Banking, Corporate Banking, Payments, Cards, Loans, or Digital Channels.  Own QA strategy, test governance, estimation, planning, execution, defect management and release sign-off.  Owns generation and delivery of test artefacts including – test strategy and plan, test cases, test execution report  Act as the primary QA point of contact for business stakeholders, product owners, architects and delivery teams.  Manage onsite/offshore QA teams, provide technical direction, mentoring, and performance feedback.  Ensure adherence to banking regulatory standards, data security, and compliance requirements.    Functional and Automation Testing Responsibilities    Define and execute end-to-end test strategies, plans, scenarios, and test cases covering functional, integration, system, UAT and regression testing.   Ensure comprehensive test coverage across core banking platforms, digital channels, APIs, batch jobs, and third-party integrations.   Lead and perform testing for payments processing, transaction validation, reconciliation, interest calculations, and exception handling to ensure business and regulatory accuracy.   Design, develop, and maintain scalable hybrid automation frameworks (POM, Data-Driven, Keyword-Driven) for Web UI (Selenium WebDriver) and API testing (Rest Assured).   Automate regression, smoke, and sanity test suites to support continuous and frequent releases.   Drive defect triage, prioritization, and resolution in collaboration with development and business teams.   Integrate automation suites with CI/CD pipelines (Maven, Azure DevOps) and ensure execution across multiple environments and browsers to support release readiness.       Collaboration & Continuous Improvement    Collaborate closely with Business Analysts, Developers, Architects, and DevOps teams to identify quality gaps early in the lifecycle.  Drive shift-left testing, continuous testing and test optimization practices.  Identify bottlenecks and implement process improvements to enhance QA efficiency and delivery predictability.  Provide regular status reports, quality metrics, risk assessments and dashboards to senior management.    Qualification & experience  Skills & Ability   Strong hands-on experience in test planning, execution and governance  Minimum 4 years experience in advanced automated testing skills using Selenium / Rest API   Agile methodology experience  Strong stakeholder management skills (including customer).  Advanced skills in problem solving, decision making and critical thinking.  Excellent written and verbal communication skills  Ability to work effectively in a team and lead junior test engineers   Knowledge & Experience   10+ years’ experience as a System Test Engineer   Good experience testing financial sector software  Strong banking domain understanding including regulatory compliance needs, AML, lifecycle management of banking product   Academic Qualifications   Bachelor’s / Master’s Degree in an IT (or related) discipline    About Company     Clitic is Technology solution provider specialising in application, services and support for Financial, Agribusiness and Manufacturing industry across Australia. Focus of Clitic is generating value and delivery certainty to our customers.     Clitic is Headquartered in Sydney, NSW, Australia .
